purpose: Validate the unchanged P5C OPEN semantic-first runtime with a test-owned AppKit semantic fixture that follows the exact application-Provider process/bundle pattern already physically validated by Computer Control Phase 9B.1, while retaining the independently validated P4/P5A visual-only fixture for the visual branch.
requiredClaims: The semantic branch uses a temporary test-owned AppKit application bundle with a temporary Computer Control Provider whose product name, activation process, executable process and bundle identity follow the same separation used by the already-physically-validated Phase 9B.1 AppKit fixture.
The temporary application Provider registry is isolated through RUMIAI_PROVIDER_DIR and the Computer Control runtime socket is isolated per physical run; no installed Provider registry is modified.
OPEN attempts the existing semantic operation before any visual perception.

The deterministic semantic target RUMIAI SEMANTIC 731 is a real accessible NSButton and its delivered action changes the same AppKit window title to RUMIAI SEMANTIC 731, providing an independent semantic postcondition observable through Computer Control.
The semantic OPEN path must complete successfully without invoking P5A, the visual perception provider or the post-action visual observer.
The visual target RUMIAI CLICK 517 is absent from the semantic fixture accessibility representation and therefore produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Only the P5B-eligible structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET result reaches the P5C visual handoff.

Visual fallback requires execution context separate from planner intent with explicit allowVisualFallback=true, an injected provider, an exact visual target matching the OPEN target, a primary-display left-click request, an exact deterministic postcondition and a post-action observer.
The planner/LLM schema remains semantic and contains no visualFallback, targetQuery, provider-selection or screen-coordinate fields.
The visual branch reuses the already-physically-validated P4/P5A visual-only fixture; P1-P4 physical sessions are not rerun.
A real P5A-coordinated Computer Control click returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false; delivery is not task success.

OPEN returns task success on the visual path only when a fresh independent post-action visual observation satisfies the exact deterministic RUMIAI DONE 864 postcondition and P4 returns VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Posted delivery without verified postcondition remains NOT_VERIFIED_SUCCESS in contract coverage.
Semantic delivery failure, semantic verification failure, readiness/backend/internal/invalid failures do not become visual retries.
The local macOS Vision helper remains only an injected PoC perception provider; P5C does not select or package a concrete provider for product runtime.
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean and no screenshot bytes, OCR payload text or action coordinates are persisted in immutable evidence.
nonClaims: P5C does not wire visual configuration or provider selection into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E after P5D.
P5C does not define concrete perception-provider discovery or selection; that is P5D.
The temporary semantic fixture is a physical-validation surface, not a product application Provider and not a new runtime dependency.
The semantic and visual branches do not need to originate from the same application process; explicit policy and deterministic caller context remain authoritative.
P5C does not add coordinates, native identifiers, visual queries or postconditions to planner output.
P5C does not make arbitrary OPEN failures visually eligible.
P5C does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy target matching, VLM/object/icon targeting, secondary/rotated display support or richer pointer actions.
The P1-P4 physical sessions are not rerun or rewritten; their immutable physical evidence remains authoritative.
P5A and P5B evidence is not rewritten by this session.
P5C s01 evidence commit 15976727c6b6a09b09b428c415c5daf74e6c0258 remains immutable as the historical unregistered custom-fixture failure.
P5C s02 evidence commit 86793f0077d0926554c71422e4394b3bf3c62b9a remains immutable as the historical registered-but-unsnapshotable custom-fixture failure.
P5C s03 evidence commit 26be209cfcdb9fa5ab81a2a23d823344c598a6d8 remains immutable as the historical LaunchServices custom-fixture snapshot failure.

P5C s04 evidence commit 630ac6c68cc7c960c01455a85dadbfb9f51abca8 remains immutable as the historical System Settings surface mismatch: the installed agent-ctrl v0.1.4 checksum matched the installer, but both adapter and direct snapshot reported no AX window found for process name System Settings.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s05 unchanged, diagnose the exact new failure, fix forward, and create s06.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned semantic and visual fixture content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted or logged by the session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P5D concrete perception-provider delivery and selection boundary
